## Research Projects

My research combines statistical methodology with collaborative biomedical
applications. I am particularly interested in developing methods for
adaptive clinical trials, survival analysis, Bayesian inference, and
statistical genomics.

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}

### Adaptive Weighting for TITE-CRM

**Adaptive Clinical Trials · Phase I Oncology**

Developing an adaptive weighting extension to the Time-to-Event Continual
Reassessment Method (TITE-CRM) for Phase I oncology trials. The work focuses
on improving dose-finding decisions when toxicity outcomes are delayed.

**Status:** Manuscript under review at *Statistics in Medicine*.

**Recent activity:** Poster presentation at JSM 2026; scheduled poster
presentation at SIP 2026.

[View project →](projects/adaptive-tite-crm.qmd)

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}

### Parkinson's Disease Transcriptomics

**Statistical Genomics · RNA-seq · Longitudinal Data**

Investigating transcriptomic signatures associated with Parkinson's disease
progression using RNA-seq data from the Parkinson's Progression Markers
Initiative (PPMI).

The project applies statistical genomics and survival-oriented methods to
identify molecular markers associated with disease progression.

**Status:** In progress.

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}

### Breast Cancer Prognostic Modeling

**Cancer Biostatistics · Survival Analysis**

Integrative prognostic modeling using gene expression and clinical data to
study breast cancer survival and identify factors associated with patient
outcomes.

**Status:** Preprint.

[View publication →](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2508.16740)

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}

### KRAS Mutation and NSCLC Survival

**Real-World Evidence · Survival Analysis**

Investigating time-varying hazard patterns and co-mutation profiles of
KRAS G12C and G12D in real-world non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

**Status:** Preprint.

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}

### Bayesian Surveillance of Cervical Dystonia

**Bayesian Methods · Clinical Monitoring**

Applying Bayesian hierarchical methods to the surveillance of cervical
dystonia treatments.

**Status:** Preprint.

[View preprint →](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.15762)

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}

### Lung Cancer Mortality Forecasting

**Time Series · Cancer Epidemiology**

Evaluating time-series forecasting methods for predicting lung cancer
mortality rates in the United States.

**Status:** Preprint.

[View preprint →](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2508.16052)

:::

:::
